subject: Senior Software Engineer
body:
I hope this message finds you well.

I am a Senior Software Engineer with over ten years of experience architecting and scaling high-impact backend systems in Python, Golang and Javascript with a recent focus on AI/ML platforms.

I am exploring new senior-level opportunities and was impressed by the work your company is doing. If you are seeking experienced engineering talent, I would love to have a conversation to discuss how my background might align with your needs.

Thank you for your consideration.

Best regards,

subject: Senior Software Engineer
body:
hope you are doing well.

I'm writing to express my strong interest in the Senior Software Engineer position. I understand you're looking for someone who can build and scale sophisticated software systems, and my background seems to be a good match.

My core expertise is in developing end-to-end solutions, from low-latency backend services with Python to dynamic, user-friendly frontends with React. I have a proven track record of integrating and optimizing real-time AI models for practical applications and designing the scalable APIs and data pipelines that power them.

If you need a software engineer who can take complex challenges in AI, distributed systems, or full-stack development and deliver robust, efficient solutions, I am confident I can help. I'm eager to apply my skills to the impactful work.

I've attached my resume for your review and would welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to your team.

Best regards,
